Syftet med G-13 är att förbättra de internationella avtalen om effektivitet i utvecklingssamarbetet och att främja en uppriktig, öppen och konstruktiv dialog med Guatemala. Från och med 2008 har gruppen ett permanent sekretariat som administreras av UNDP och alla medlemmar bidrar till finansieringen av sekretariatet.

The purpose of G-13 is to enhance the international agreements of efficiency of development cooperation and to promote a sincere, open and constructive dialogue with Guatemala. As of 2008 the group has a permanent secretariat administered by the UNDP and all members contribute to the financing of the secretariat.

The content of the agendas of the meetings of the GoD, the GCC and the joint meetings was prepared by the G13 Permanent Secretariat. The Pro Tempore Presidency of Sweden established as its main goal to promote the dialogue between the G13 and the Government, involving various institutions states, the private sector and civil society around issues fundamental. With this purpose, the Embassy led the call and organization of a total of 12 meetings.
